motionPrompts.prompt:
Vertical 9:16 scene, about 8 seconds, on a charcoal #101412 base, with the lower quarter permanently reserved for yellow subtitles. All on-screen labels are Spanish; hierarchy stays professional with exactly one focal point per variant.

Editorial variant — kinetic typography: JUVENTUS and STADE RENNAIS slam in from opposite edges in warm white #edf0e6 condensed caps, then the heading FORMA RECIENTE ticks across the upper third in lime #c5ed74. Three rhythmic beats follow: VICTORIAS pulses in lime with a camera push-in, EMPATES settles in slate #8ca6bf, DERROTAS drops in dimmed warm white; each word lands on the beat with a 2-frame shake and a quick echo, while abstract rounded blocks rise behind the type as pure rhythm, never as data axes and never as sample claims. Exit: all type collapses into a horizontal lime rule that wipes downward.

Statistical variant — grouped count bars: two team columns, Juventus left and Stade Rennais right, each with three grouped bars labelled Victorias, Empates and Derrotas on one shared zero baseline, unit partidos, common scale with slate whole-number gridlines so heights compare directly. Bars spring from the baseline with slight overshoot and count-up numerals resolved from {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}} and {{home.losses}} for Juventus, and {{away.wins}}, {{away.draws}} and {{away.losses}} for Stade Rennais; a zero resolves as a flat baseline bar whose label stays visible. Sample treatment: chips under each team read Muestra: {{home.n}} partidos and Muestra: {{away.n}} partidos; counts are never normalized into rates, and if the resolved samples differ, the unequal samples remain visible on the shared scale. Source annotation in small slate caps: Fuente: Bzzoiro. Emphasis: the Victorias group carries a lime edge as the single focal point. Temporal stages: axis in, left column grows, right column grows, emphasis pulse, hold. Camera: locked-off with a subtle push on the pulse. Transition out: bars sink to the baseline and the panel slides up into the next block.
